name: Act of June 1, 1872 for partition of the Meshingomesia reserve among the band
promises: Congress provided that the tract reserved for Meshingomesia's band by the treaty of November 28, 1840 be partitioned among the members of the band (Royce schedule).

sources.title: Charles C. Royce, Indian Land Cessions in the United States (18th Annual Report of the Bureau of American Ethnology, 1899), schedule p. 856
Charles C. Royce, Indian Land Cessions in the United States (18th Annual Report of the Bureau of American Ethnology, 1899), schedule p. 857

openQuestions: A partition of a band reserve into individual holdings, not a cession to the United States; Royce maps it under area 256 (Indiana detail).
The ICC title search for "miami" lists 85 decisions (Dockets 67, 76, 124, 251, 253, 255, 256 and others); none located concerns the Meshingomesia partition, but not every decision was read.

The present-day nation in treaties.json is the Miami Tribe of Oklahoma; the Meshingomesia band's descendants are largely in Indiana (Miami Nation of Indians of Indiana), which is not federally recognised. Not settled who should be named.
